name: Jesimiel
overview: Jesimiel is a male figure identified as a member of the tribe of Simeon. His unique attribute is noted in 1 Chronicles 4:36, where he is listed among the Simeonites. There are no additional notes or detailed descriptions about his life or character.
namesAndTitles: The name Jesimiel means 'G-d [El] will establish,' reflecting a theologically significant meaning rooted in the Hebrew language. This proper name is recorded in 1 Chronicles 4:36 and is not indicated as being given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Jesimiel is explicitly recorded as a descendant of Simeon, linking him directly to the tribe of Simeon as stated in 1 Chronicles 4:36. Scripture does not provide further family relationships beyond this tribal connection.
scriptureSignificance: Jesimiel's significance lies primarily in his identification as a Simeonite, contributing to the genealogical record that traces the descendants of Simeon. This genealogical mention underscores the faithfulness of God in establishing the tribes of Israel as part of His covenantal promises. Although brief, Jesimiel's inclusion in the biblical record affirms the continuity of God's people through the tribe of Simeon.
